tabs.content:
let ts_now = toscalar(
    energy_latest
    | where endpoint == "signal" and ts <= now()
    | summarize max(ts));
energy_latest
| where endpoint == "signal" and ts == ts_now
| summarize TrafficLight = toint(maxif(value, series_id == "signal")),
            RenewableShare = round(maxif(value, series_id == "share"), 1)
    by ts
| project TrafficLight, RenewableShare, AsOf = datetime_utc_to_local(ts, "Europe/Berlin")
| render card
tabs.title: Alert 1+2: Traffic Light
Alert 3: High Export

tabs.content:
energy_raw
| where ingestion_time() > ago(1d)
| summarize LastIngestionUtc = max(ingestion_time())
| project MinutesWithoutData = datetime_diff("minute", now(), LastIngestionUtc),
          LastIngestion = datetime_utc_to_local(LastIngestionUtc, "Europe/Berlin")
| render card
tabs.title: Alert 4: Data Outage

tabs.content:
let tomorrow = startofday(datetime_utc_to_local(now(), "Europe/Berlin")) + 1d;
energy_latest
| where endpoint == "price"
| extend Time = datetime_utc_to_local(ts, "Europe/Berlin")
| where Time >= tomorrow and Time < tomorrow + 1d
| summarize NegativeQuarterHoursTomorrow = countif(value < 0),
            MinPrice_ct_kWh = round(min(value) / 10, 2)
| render card
tabs.title: Alert 5: Negative Prices Tomorrow

tabs.content:
energy_latest
| where endpoint == "price" and ts <= now()
| top 1 by ts desc
| project Price_ct_kWh = round(value / 10, 2),
          AsOf = datetime_utc_to_local(ts, "Europe/Berlin")
| render card
tabs.title: Alert 6: Price Negative Now

tabs.content:
let last_ts = toscalar(GridFrequency() | summarize max(ts));
GridFrequency()
| where ts > last_ts - 6m
| summarize MaxDeviation_mHz = max(abs(deviation_mhz)),
            Lowest_Hz = round(min(hz), 3),
            Highest_Hz = round(max(hz), 3)
| extend AsOf = datetime_utc_to_local(last_ts, "Europe/Berlin")
| render card
tabs.title: Alert 7: Frequency Deviation
